ITEM 1 | White, fluffy, separate grains with slight sheen, mounded on the upper right of the plate, roughly 9 cm across and 2 cm high, dry surface, sits beside the roasted wedges | 150
ITEM 2 | Sliced pale cooked meat with light golden-brown searing on edges, fibrous texture, lying in overlapping slices about 8 cm long on the left-center of the plate, sitting near the broccoli | 110
ITEM 3 | Bright green broccoli florets with compact tops and thick pale stems, several clusters about 3 to 4 cm across, scattered in the center-left area, slightly glossy with a few darker tips | 100
ITEM 4 | Cubed pieces of golden-brown fried or seared material, about 2 cm per cube, matte surface with crisp edges, a few scattered among the broccoli and sliced meat | 45
ITEM 5 | Thick wedge-shaped potato-like pieces with dark caramelized brown glossy glaze and charred edges, about 8 to 10 cm long, arranged in a fan along the lower right of the plate, sticky-looking sheen | 140
ITEM 6 | Pale yellow-white onion slivers, limp and translucent, small amount tucked among the broccoli and cubes | 10
ITEM 7 | Dark brown glossy sauce residue pooled and smeared on the plate around the wedges and meat, thin film with some sheen | 15
